page.overview:
Who is Ayame?

Ayame is a kind and cheerful young woman. She and her father seem to be some of the few Konoha villagers that do not see Naruto in a hostile light and consider him their favourite regular customer. She is a hard-working woman, always doing her best to serve Naruto with ramen. Occasionally, she and her father would gladly serve Naruto with free ramen depending on a situation, such as allowing Naruto to eat for free before his fight at the Chūnin Exams as a way to encourage him.

During the brief period in which the store began serving tsukemen instead of ramen, Ayame was proud of her culinary training, refusing to serve anything less than a perfect cuisine, to the point of bickering with Naruto over not serving him ramen and the time it took to serve him altogether, but was subsequently forced to bitterly admit her pride in Naruto eating three bowls despite unhappy on the manner of which Naruto ate it.

In the anime, it was shown that Ayame was attracted to Kakashi Hatake, after seeing his face as he eats ramen.

Ayame is a slender girl with long, dark brown hair and large black eyes, plus fair skin. She wears a white robe with the sleeves folded, a sort of dark blue apron with ribbon ties at the top and a bright white bandanna.
